dct_title_s: Niuewe Kaart van Caap der Goede Hoop in hare rechte jegenwoordige staat vertoond door
dct_description_sm: Appears in: Valentijn's Oud en Nieuw Oost Indien, vol. 5 (1724-1726)
Inset: Detail of the Cape Peninsula with names of farms and their owners. Top right: No. 43. This map "served as a source for other map makers over a number of years."

Norwich, I., Pam Kolbe, and Jeffrey C Stone. Norwich's Maps of Africa: An Illustrated and Annotated Carto-Bibliography. 2nd ed. / rev. and edited by Jeffrey C. Stone. Norwich, Vt.: Terra Nova Press, 1997, map 0214, p. 241
David Rumsey Map Center copy 1: Norwich no. NOR 0214.
